```{r}
library("tidyverse")
library("here")
```

## Locate RNA-seq files

```{r}
files <- list.files(
  "../data/_raw",
  recursive = TRUE,
  pattern = "gene_counts.tsv$",
  full.names = TRUE
)

length(files)
```

## Function to read one file

```{r}
# ideen bag det er vi vil gerne importere count data uden at få meta data med.
# vi vil også fjerene secuencerings diagonestic da det ikke r gen data. 
# vi smider sample_id på for at så vi hvor hvilken sample de kommer fra. 
read_count_file <- function(file) {
  
  sample_id <- basename(dirname(file))
  
  read_tsv(
    file,
    comment = "#",
    show_col_types = FALSE
  ) |>
    select(
      gene_id,
      gene_name,
      gene_type,
      unstranded
    ) |>
    filter(
      !str_detect(gene_id, "^N_")
    ) |>
    mutate(
      sample_id = sample_id
    )
}
```

## Read all files

```{r}
# her er ideen at smidder det hele ind i et data set.
count_data <- map_dfr(
  files,
  read_count_file
)

glimpse(count_data)
```

## Save cleaned data

```{r}
write_tsv(
  count_data,
  "../data/02_dat_clean.tsv")
```

# New version 

## Load data

```{r}
data_dir <- here("data")
clean_df <- readr::read_tsv(file = file.path(data_dir,
                                             "01_dat_load.tsv.gz"), 
                            col_names = TRUE,     
                            show_col_types = FALSE)
```

## Clean data

```{r}
clean_df <- clean_df |>   
  drop_na(gene_name) |>   
  mutate(sample_id = basename(dirname(file))) |>   
  select(c("sample_id",             
           "gene_id",             
           "gene_name",             
           "gene_type",             
           "unstranded"))
```

## Write data file

```{r}
readr::write_tsv(clean_df,
                 file.path(data_dir, 
                           "02_dat_clean.tsv.gz"))
```
